title: Device and account security attestation
intro: Answer for every device you use to reach the organization's systems. A 'no' fails the attestation; fix it and submit again.

questions.prompt: Does the screen lock automatically after 15 minutes or less?
Are automatic operating system updates turned on?
Is multi-factor authentication on for every work account that supports it?
Do you keep work passwords only in the approved password manager?
Which devices do you use for work (model and operating system)?
